title: Godot breaks window manager and tiling on linux
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.7.2.stable

### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable (ed1daf0bf) - CachyOS Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri, 09 Oct 2026 14:19:38 +0000 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (nvidia; 615.78.08) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900K (32 threads) - 62.47 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

The launcher opens up perfectly, but when I open a project it completely breaks my window tiling (I'm using the [Krohnkite plasma 6 fork](https://codeberg.org/anametologin/Krohnkite), and I've set a minimum window size which is recommended), Other windows stop tiling properly or at all, and godot takes up the full screen resolution (settings do not seem to change it), and cannot be minimized or resized, and it persists even after closing godot, but restarting fixes it.

I'm aware it sounds like an issue with the tiling script, I'm not an expert, but I've been daily driving it for months without any issues, and I've only ever been able to replicate this with godot, when opening a godot project. I've tried many different potential fixes & different settings both inside & outside godot, and nothing seems to fix or change the problem.

### Steps to reproduce

- Setup CachyOS /w KDE Plasma (/w official wiki) and Krohnkite (any installation method)
- Install `godot` from Shelly
- Launch "Godot Engine"
- Create a new project (any renderer, version control, etc)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
